metadata.description: Curated threat intelligence sources for custom Playwright ingestion pipeline. Sources selected for maximum actor coverage, alias mapping, and TTP extraction value.

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK Groups
sources.notes: Core baseline. Official MITRE ATT&CK group definitions with technique mappings. Updates monthly. Also available via house-of-hunting MITRE tools (get_threat_group, search_threat_groups). Scrape for alias cross-reference and new group additions.

sources.name: Mandiant / Google Threat Intelligence Blog
sources.notes: Tier 1 vendor. Best animal naming (APT1-43). Deep APT profiles with full technique chains. MCP tool exists (mandiant_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary. Also see APT groups page: https://cloud.google.com/security/resources/insights/apt-groups

sources.name: CrowdStrike Adversary Universe
sources.notes: Tier 1 vendor. 257+ adversary profiles. Fastest naming updates (weekly). Bear=Russia, Spider=eCrime, Panda=China, Kitten=Iran, Chollima=DPRK, Jackal=Hacktivist. MCP tool exists (crowdstrike_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary.

sources.name: Microsoft Threat Actor Naming & Intelligence
sources.notes: Tier 1 vendor. Weather-based taxonomy (Typhoon=China, Sandstorm=Iran, Blizzard=Russia, Sleet=DPRK, Tempest=eCrime, Storm=Emerging). Best for Microsoft ecosystem + cloud threats. MCP tool exists (microsoft_search_reports) but RSS-limited. Also see taxonomy reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/unified-secops/microsoft-threat-actor-naming

sources.name: Symantec / Broadcom Threat Intelligence Blog
sources.notes: Tier 2 vendor. Strong legacy actor naming (W32.* malware families). Good coverage of older + continuing campaigns. No MCP tool — Playwright only.

sources.name: Kaspersky Securelist APT Reports
sources.notes: Tier 1 vendor. GReAT team tracks 900+ APT groups. Strongest on Russian and Eastern European actors (Sofacy, Turla, Lazarus). MCP tool exists (kaspersky_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary.

sources.name: Recorded Future Insikt Group Research
sources.notes: Gold standard for alias mapping and actor timelines. Insikt Group produces high-quality actor profiles. Some content may be paywalled — Playwright will extract what is publicly available. No MCP tool — Playwright only.

sources.name: Group-IB Threat Research Blog
sources.notes: No MCP tool. Known to block server-side fetchers (ti_report_ingest returned 403). MUST use Playwright. Strong on Eastern European cybercrime and financial actors. Published MuddyWater and supply-chain research relevant to UAE engagement.

sources.name: Secureworks CTU Threat Profiles
sources.notes: Counter Threat Unit (CTU) profiles. Naming: IRON=Russia, BRONZE=China, COBALT=Iran, NICKEL=DPRK, GOLD=eCrime. Quarterly updates. Strong on malware family attribution. No MCP tool — Playwright only.

sources.name: Unit 42 / Palo Alto Networks Threat Research
sources.notes: Tier 1 vendor. Excellent technical depth on actor reports. Weekly updates. 750+ major incident analyses in 2026 IR report. MCP tool exists (unit42_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary.

sources.name: Cisco Talos Intelligence Blog
sources.notes: Good for network-centric threat actors and infrastructure-level analysis. Weekly updates. Tracks UAT-* actors. No dedicated MCP tool — Playwright only.

sources.name: Dragos OT/ICS Threat Intelligence Blog
sources.notes: ICS/OT specialist. Tracks 23+ OT threat groups (KAMACITE, ELECTRUM, VOLTZITE, SYLVANITE, PYROXENE, AZURITE). Essential for industrial/energy sector hunts. MCP tool exists (dragos_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary. 2026 report: 119 ransomware groups hit 3,300 industrial orgs.

sources.name: SentinelOne SentinelLabs Research
sources.notes: Modern ransomware and APT focus. Strong on China-nexus actors (PurpleHaze, ShadowPad research). Weekly updates. No dedicated MCP tool — Playwright only. CAUTION: SentinelOne may have JS-heavy pages, increase wait_seconds if needed.

sources.name: The DFIR Report
sources.notes: GOLD STANDARD for real-world TTPs. Detailed case studies of actual intrusions with full MITRE ATT&CK mapping, evidence, and detection guidance. Also publishes Sigma rules and YARA rules on GitHub (github.com/The-DFIR-Report). MCP tool exists (dfir_report_search_reports) but RSS-limited — Playwright is primary.

sources.name: APT Groups and Operations Wiki (Google Sheets)
sources.notes: MUST-HAVE for alias cross-reference. Community-maintained Google Sheet mapping ALL known actor aliases across ALL vendors. Updated weekly. Best single source for resolving CrowdStrike<->Microsoft<->MITRE<->Kaspersky naming overlaps. No MCP tool — Playwright only. NOTE: Google Sheets may require specific Playwright handling.
